camel_example: aliyun cdn DeleteRealtimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project ProjectName --Logstore LogstoreName --Region 'cn-shanghai' --Domain 'example.com'
description_en: Deletes real-time log delivery for specific accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DeleteRealtimeLogDelivery删除实时日志推送域名
kebab_example: aliyun cdn delete-realtime-log-delivery --domain example.com --project ProjectName --logstore LogstoreName --biz-region cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteRealtimeLogDelivery

parameters.help_en: The acceleration domain name for which you want to disable real-time log delivery. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 删除实时日志投递服务域名，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The name of the Logstore where log entries are stored
parameters.name: logstore

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144883.html
parameters.help_zh: 实时投递sls的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144883.html
parameters.name: region
